{{Quotation|game|Any hero arriving at the Gate of Pain knows that it leads nowhere except to pain and destruction... destruction of sanity, hope, joy, and ultimately, an end to life itself. Beyond these gates the souls of those touched by [[Abaddon]] are imprisoned, their existence drained they are nothing more than spirits who have forgotten their offense and their previous life.}}
{{Quotation|[[gw.dat]]|The Gate of Pain is one of the great locks erected by the five gods to imprison Abaddon. Located on the first layer of the Realm of Torment, the lock was sundered when Varesh completed her convocation with Abaddon, allowing the fallen lord to coalesce enough of his godform to begin extruding parts of his tormented realm into the real world. Past the gate lies a river of tormented souls damned to live in Abaddon's pain forever. }}
The fleshy [[Gate of Pain (outpost)|Gate of Pain]] is one of the eight locks imprisoning Abaddon and the main entryway into the [[Domain of Pain]].

==Getting there==
The party will wind up here upon completion of the [[primary quest]] [[Uncharted Territory]].

This outpost is located along the northern edge of [[Nightfallen Jahai]] and it can be found by entering and climbing the ruins of the Fortress of Jahai.
